gc_reference.DEGENERATE_MY_DESIGN_FAILED: This arm did NOT work as designed and is not a usable reference. I intended it as a scale for how much a nonlinear probe buys when there is little structure to find; instead the MLP scored WORSE than logistic on GC (median gain -0.1776) and swung from 0.3871 to 0.7631 across seeds. That is an MLP failing on a SINGLE standardised feature with early stopping on a tiny internal validation split, not a fact about nonlinearity. Do not quote the GC gain as evidence of anything. What survives from it is weak and worth stating: the probe is not magically strong.
gc_reference.why: GC is ONE feature, so a nonlinear probe on it can only exploit a non-monotone relationship. It is the reference for how much a nonlinear probe buys when there is almost no structure to find, which keeps the embedding gain in scale.

question: Is the control-vs-tile detection signal in this embedding LINEARLY encoded? That bounds the one caveat the linear removal experiments structurally cannot touch.
reading_rule_fixed_in_advance: nonlinear gain over linear < 0.02 => almost all detectable signal is LINEAR, so the linear subspace removal deleted almost all of it and the 'nonlinear survives' caveat is TIGHT. A larger gain => real detection headroom was left behind and the caveat is LOOSE.
what_this_does_NOT_license: It is NOT 'exposure excluded'. A tight bound says the signal a linear projection could not reach is SMALL on this control cohort and this embedding -- narrower than claiming no nonlinear exposure exists.
It is a bound on a PROBE, not a removal: nothing nonlinear was projected out.
One MLP architecture (64 hidden units, early stopping). A larger probe might find more, though it would also overfit 1,406 controls faster.
NOT pre-registered in the frozen bar; corroboration only, and it cannot change the graded verdict label.
why_the_embedding_number_is_still_readab: The contrast between the two arms is the reassurance. The embedding gain is positive on 10 of 10 seeds in a tight band (+0.0031 to +0.0164, median +0.0082), while the GC arm swings 0.39-0.76. A noisy estimator producing a stable, uniformly-signed, small result on one input and chaos on another is behaving like a probe with little left to find in the first case -- which is the claim. It is corroboration, not proof.
